description:
Standalone cross-platform desktop app for SFMC Data Extension export/import.

A standalone desktop application that wraps the sfmc-dataloader CLI to make exporting and importing Salesforce Marketing Cloud Data Extensions easy, without needing to install Node.js or use the command line.
## Bugfixes

• Keep one active transfer or connection-save job at a time, retain progress and cancellation controls across navigation, and wait for the worker to exit before accepting another job.
• Reject stale Business Unit and Data Extension selections and ignore out-of-order list responses.
• Use native confirmation dialogs for clearing rows, with frozen target details and exact typed confirmation. Improve keyboard focus and dismissal for telemetry consent.
• Bound and batch recent job output, preserve the latest messages, and avoid pulling the log back to the bottom while you read earlier output.
• List saved connections without reading authentication contents, and preserve safe diagnostics and unsuccessful or unverified import outcomes.

Cancellation stops local work; it does not roll back cleared or written rows, and already-submitted remote imports may still finish.

## Dependencies

• Update the bundled `sfmc-dataloader` engine from 3.1.0 to 3.2.0.

**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/JoernBerkefeld/sfmc-dataloader-app/compare/v0.6.0...v0.6.1
